Reviewed shared mode parsing/default, person sender refusal, bounded send frames, keyed non-delivery recovery, summary/detail delivery fields and Task-owned evidence verification against route/store/inbox callers. HTTP fixture and fault results are recorded in the round report; no live-provider proof. Legacy keys without a mode still recover known non-delivery, while uncertain delivery replay fails closed.

Reviewed additive shared send mode and refusal codes against parser bounds and route/SDK consumers. Evidence flags require exact commit type and Task-linked current passing gate refs. The merged R4 summary/detail and relocation contracts are retained.

Reviewed shared TaskReviewSendRequest consumption, send list/detail invalidation and retry semantics. The inherited summary/detail APIs and three-second opt-in polling behavior are retained. Local hook tests do not qualify browser UI or providers.
